page.mainText: Home Custom Business Software For small businesses in Ottawa and across Canada Custom Business Software Software built around a business's own workflows. Discuss your project Explore relevant work Is this a fit? When this service can help Important work is spread across spreadsheets, email and handwritten notes, making it hard to see what needs attention. An off-the-shelf product forces awkward workarounds or cannot represent the way your business handles a job. Staff or customers need a clearer way to submit information, follow progress or find the records relevant to them. Potential deliverables What we can build together The right scope depends on your business. A project could include: An internal tool for tracking jobs, requests or approvals through the steps your business actually uses. A customer or staff portal with access to the information and actions each person needs. A dashboard that brings agreed business information into one place for review. A quoting tool built around your pricing rules, review steps and required inputs. Connections to existing systems where their access, data and integration options support the workflow. Clear boundaries from the start These are examples of possible tools, not a list of completed client projects. The first version is defined around a specific business need and the people who will use it. Data access, permissions, privacy needs and any migration from existing records are agreed before building. Connections depend on what each existing system permits. Hosting, backups, third-party fees and ongoing maintenance need their own scope. Running a business application has different requirements from hosting a static website. Ownership, handover, documentation and future changes are discussed explicitly. Cost and timing depend on the agreed workflow and technical requirements. We first consider whether an existing tool can meet the need with reasonable configuration. Custom software may make sense when the workflow has requirements that available products cannot accommodate well. The decision includes ongoing running and maintenance costs, not just the initial build. Can we start with one part of the workflow? Yes. A useful first version can focus on one process, a defined group of users and a small set of tasks. We agree what success looks like and review that version before deciding whether to extend it. Can existing spreadsheets and systems be part of the project? They can be a starting point for understanding the work. We review the structure and quality of the records, the rules behind them and the access each system allows. Data cleanup, migration and integrations are included only when agreed in the scope. What should we bring to the first conversation? Describe one task that is difficult today: who does it, what information they use, where it gets stuck and what a better outcome would look like. page.mainText: Home Privacy Privacy notice Last updated: October 30, 2026 . This notice explains how Ternloom Technologies handles the information you share when you contact us about a project, and how the embedded contact form processes information. Information you share The contact form asks for your name, email address, service choice and project message. You can also provide your business name and website URL; these fields are optional. If you email us, we receive your email address, message and any other information you choose to include. The form also records where an enquiry came from and whether it was sent through a test or public version of the form. The form and security providers may process device, browser and connection information, such as an IP address, to operate their services and help prevent abuse. Please avoid including passwords, payment details or sensitive personal information in your enquiry. How we use enquiry information We use your information to respond to you, assess and discuss your project, and maintain relevant enquiry and project records. Sending an enquiry does not subscribe you to a newsletter or give consent to advertising. Form and security providers Our contact form uses Tally. Tally stores submitted responses and sends email notifications, so enquiry information can also be held in our email account. The form uses Google reCAPTCHA to help prevent automated abuse. These providers may process information outside Canada. Their services and processing practices are described in Tally's data processing information and Google's Privacy Policy . Google reCAPTCHA is also subject to Google's Terms of Service . How long we keep enquiries Our policy is to delete active enquiry copies within 12 months of submission, unless they are needed for an ongoing project or required records. This includes responses held in Tally, enquiry emails and any exported copies we retain. We delete these records manually. Copies in providers' trash and backup systems may remain for their normal deletion cycles after an active copy is deleted. Cookies and website measurement We have not added first-party visitor analytics or advertising tracking to this website. Embedded services, including Tally and Google reCAPTCHA on the contact page, may process device and connection information and use cookies to provide their services and security checks. You can email us directly using the address below if you prefer not to use the embedded form. Privacy questions and requests For privacy questions, or to request access to, correction of or deletion of your enquiry information, email info@ternloom.com . You can also use this address to send a project enquiry directly. Include enough detail to help us locate your enquiry. We may ask for information to verify your identity before sharing or changing records. We will review your request and explain any information that needs to be retained for an ongoing project or required records.
